text:
Keisha M: quick sync on Routing Policies UX: users get confused when multiple rules match. proposal: compact 'ordering insight' chip on rule rows + a transient Simulation overlay that points to the single winner. Need copy + a11y plan.

Omar V: chip idea 👍 — keep it tiny: 10px stripe + 'shadowed' label on hover. show winner pointer only in simulation mode.

Ben R: copy options: 'Shadowed by earlier rule' vs 'Will not run: earlier match' — prefer the second, shorter.

Lena Q: accessibility: add aria-live polite for simulation changes but debounce 400ms; chips should have aria-describedby for details. also provide keyboard focus to open simulation overlay.

Keisha M: validation on save: default to non-blocking warn banner: 'Saved — 2 rules shadowed. View details.' Enterprise toggle to block saves.

Omar V: interaction note: when dragging reorder, animate chip position and delay aria announcement until drop.

a11y-bot: checklist added: aria-live debounce, focusable chips, descriptive aria text, keyboard shortcut to open overlay.

Keisha M: action items: decide final microcopy (Keisha + Ben), handoff aria snippet (Lena), prototype sim overlay (Omar).
